scope: Chance per chest opened, outside Treasure Hours. Rewards are granted to your account automatically. Each weekly item can only be obtained once per week (gizmos excepted).

items.name: Weekly Gold Outfit
items.note: Week 1: Solid Gold A$AP Rocky. Week 2: Solid Gold Lil Uzi Vert.

items.name: Pirate Shop Access
items.note: Free Item Shop access (2026 & 2027). Epic says the Treasure Hours boost may sometimes be higher; one session reached 2x.

items.name: Weekly Vehicle & Decal
items.note: Week 1: Mercedes-AMG G 63 and Golden Llama Crew decal. Week 2: Gold Cadillac Blackwing.

items.name: Weekly Pickaxe or Back Bling
items.note: Week 1: Solid Gold A$AP Rocky Gauntlets. Week 2: Lil' Uzi Crew.

items.name: Weekly Loading Screen
items.note: Week 1: Plunder in Paradise. Week 2: So Kawaii.

items.name: Any Gizmo
items.note: Extraction Accelerator, Portable Extractor, Golden Firework, Sprite Locator or Lucky Locator.

treasureHours.note: Times in UTC. confirmed = announced by Epic (@FortniteStatus); otherwise expected from the Saturday pattern (2-4 pm and 9-11 pm ET). Update when Epic announces a session.

caveats: Whether Rare chests, Sprite chests and refilled chests use the same rates has not been confirmed individually.
Regular chest loot (weapons, consumables, rarity tiers) is not published by Epic. Only datamined estimates exist, so none are shown here.
Rates are independent for every chest: there is no pity system and no guarantee after any number of chests.
Some Treasure Hours have a higher boost, announced by Epic (on 7 Nov 2026, 9–11 pm ET: 2x Pirate Shop and 10x gold outfit).
